game_title: The Lost Legacy of C · History/classification review
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Sand Dunes – Mirage Road, a road of shimmering mirages: the scarab scholar must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Syntax Sweep: Spot and fix syntax errors such as missing colons or brackets before the program runs.
theme: Sand Dunes – Mirage Road: a road of shimmering mirages
core_gameplay_loop: Search the archive, examine recovered computing artifacts, and use their evidence to verify the assigned C lesson.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Case 1: Find 5 artifacts, read the evidence, and verify three findings about History/classification review.
controls: Select objects in the room. Review discovered objects in Evidence and verify your findings. Tab and Enter select controls. Escape closes a card or pauses.
win_condition: Recover all 5 artifacts and answer all three evidence checks correctly.
lose_condition: The case ends when the available incorrect evidence checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared archive artwork, illustrated artifacts, and Kenney interface audio.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Syntax Sweep' (Week 9 slot 1), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Mirage Road'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Match the silhouettes in the tray to the objects in the room.
Inspect each artifact to read its history.
Open Evidence to review the records and verify your findings.
source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the caravan wagon by solving code steps involving syntax_errors that move the scarab scholar forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.6).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the caravan wagon first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Match an unfound object in the tray to its shape in the room. The Evidence folder keeps every record you uncover.
